projects.title: Flashys

projects.title: Project Rosa
projects.description: Mixed Reality colocated furniture and home decor platform that lets users visualize new furniture in their homes on Meta Quest before purchasing. Developed with a team of 2 developers and 2 designers during MIT's Reality Hack 2025.
projects.shortDescription: Mixed Reality furniture and home decor platform on Meta Quest.

projects.title: Spotify Wrapped
projects.description: Collaborated with a team to build a full-stack web app using Python (Django) and HTML/CSS that visualizes users’ top artists, songs, and genres from Spotify; deployed on Heroku for public access.
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack web app that visualizes Spotify users' top artists, songs, and genres.
